verdicts.why: The selected test demonstrates that a backup whose snapshot was fixed before a concurrent write restores the complete pre-write state, not an intermediate state. It does not assert that every kept backup is encrypted or checked, nor does it induce a failed check and verify that such a backup is not kept.
